tasks.prompt:
Trigger a nightly release build for voice-typing. Steps:
1. cd /Users/boyao/workspace/my/voice_input
2. Get current version from src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
3. Create a nightly tag: v{version}-nightly.{YYYYMMDD}
4. Push the tag to trigger the Release workflow
5. Wait for build to complete, then publish the release
Run: date_str=$(date +%Y%m%d) && version=$(grep '"version"' src-tauri/tauri.conf.json | head -1 | sed 's/.*"\([0-9.]*\)".*/\1/') && tag="v${version}-nightly.${date_str}" && cd /Users/boyao/workspace/my/voice_input && git tag -a "$tag" -m "Nightly build $date_str" && git push origin "$tag"
